title: Float style — blur on each small button?

steps.path: Bottom of the chat, scrolled up a little so a message passes under the buttons
steps.headline: Should each small button and chip keep its own blur, or only the message box and session switcher?
steps.notice: Look closely at the quick buttons and status buttons: with the blur off, the wallpaper behind them is a little sharper. The message box looks the same in both. The header buttons change the same way.

variants.label: Each button blurs (today)
variants.summary: About 20 small buttons each blur what is behind them. The look you approved.
variants.risk: Twice before, about 20 separately blurred pieces redrawing during a reply made parts of the app flicker or vanish on Windows. Not tested on Windows here.

variants.label: Only the big pieces blur
variants.summary: The small buttons keep their faint fill, thin edge and shadow but stop blurring. The message box and session switcher keep their frost.
variants.risk: Over a busy wallpaper the buttons look slightly less frosted, and the wallpaper behind their text is a little sharper.
